28/7/16

Shanghai Municipal Council.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH.)

29th July 1913

Sir,

Admiral Sah is expected to arrive here within the
next few days.

One fourth of the Arsenal workmen will be dismissed
on 1st August 1916.

The cruiser Hun Yoong 海容 left Woosung for Canton
on 27th instant.

（批：N? / Cin）

A petition has been sent to the Arsenal Authorities
signed by several Woosung shopkeepers complaining of
the improper conduct of the troops in that town. They
allege that the soldiers are in the habit of taking
things from their shops without paying.

Dr. Sun Yat Sen has received a telegram from the
Parliamentarians saying that they have arrived safely
in Peking, and thanking him for the reception he and
his friends gave them in Shanghai.

Your obedient servant,

（签名）
Chief Detective Inspector.

（批：K.J. / Q.H）

ptain Superintendent of Police.

28/7/16

上海工部局。

（印：上海工部局）
警务处，
（侦探股。）

1913年7月29日

先生：

萨海军上将预计将于未来数日内抵达此地。

兵工厂四分之一的工人将于1916年8月1日被解雇。

“海容”号巡洋舰于本月27日离开吴淞前往广州。

（批注：N? / Cin）

数名吴淞店主签署了一份请愿书并递交给兵工厂当局，投诉该镇驻军行为不端。他们指控士兵习惯于从店铺中拿取物品而不付款。

孙中山博士已收到国会议员发来的电报，称他们已安全抵达北京，并感谢孙博士及其朋友在上海给予他们的接待。

您顺从的仆人，

（签名）
总探长。

（批注：K.J. / Q.H）

警察总监。
